title: feat(plugin-chatbot): an assistant answer fits the narrow side panel (objectui#13032)
body:
Fixes #13032
Clause-②: no

An assistant answer in the console's narrow assistant panel now reads at chat scale. Each of the card's four targets lands as ruled; the optional card-per-row table layout under 480px is **not** in scope and is not implemented.

## What changed

| Ruling | Where | What |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 1. Headings | `elements/message.tsx` (`MessageResponse` components) | h1 renders `text-base font-bold`, h2 `text-[15px] font-bold`, h3 `text-[15px] font-semibold`. All three are 15–16px. Hierarchy comes from weight and top margin, no longer from streamdown's article scale (`text-3xl` / `text-2xl` / `text-xl`). |
| 2. Wide tables | `elements/message.tsx` | `th` and `td` are 13px. The first cell of every row is `sticky left-0` with an opaque background and a right border, so the first column stays frozen while the other columns scroll. When a table's scroll box overflows (`scrollWidth > clientWidth`, re-measured by a `ResizeObserver` on the answer), streamdown's existing fullscreen ("expand") button is marked `data-chat-table-expand=overflow` and styled as a labelled, bordered pill that reads its localized title (「展开」 / "Expand"). While the table fits, the button keeps streamdown's own quiet icon style. |
| 3. Long answers fold | `elements/message.tsx` | An answer whose body is taller than `ANSWER_FOLD_VIEWPORTS = 2` heights of its scroll container folds to `max-h-[28rem]` with a fade, plus a 「展开全文」 / "Show full answer" button. Once expanded, the button reads 「收起」 / "Collapse" and folds the answer again. The answer is never folded while `isAnimating` is true; the fold is decided only after the stream ends. |
| 4. Scroll-to-bottom button | `elements/conversation.tsx` | The conversation is now a flex column: the message list (`min-h-0 flex-1`) on top, and the button in its own `shrink-0` row below the list. The button is no longer `absolute` over the list, so at no scroll position does it sit on text, a table or a heading. The row only exists while the button is visible (`!isAtBottom`). |

New strings `chatbot.answer.showFull` / `collapse` / `expandTable` / `exitExpandedTable` ship in all ten locale packs. Nothing new is exported. The threshold and the marker are module-local constants.

## One line outside the claimed file surface — please review

The claim's surface is `message.tsx`, `conversation.tsx`, the locale bundles, tests and the changeset. Ruling 3 ("never folded while streaming") cannot be met inside that surface. On `origin/main` the answer call site in `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` renders `MessageResponse` with the content and nothing else, so nothing in `elements/` can tell whether the answer is still streaming. This PR adds one prop at that call site: `isAnimating={Boolean(message.streaming)}`. `isAnimating` is streamdown's own prop, so `MessageResponseProps` gains no new key. Inside streamdown, the flag only disables the copy, download and fullscreen controls while streaming. I checked the open objectui PRs: none touches `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`, `message.tsx` or `conversation.tsx`. If the seat prefers to keep the call site out of this PR, drop that hunk; rulings 1, 2 and 4 stand without it, but ruling 3 would then fold during streaming.

`MessageResponse`'s memo comparator now also compares `isAnimating`. Before, it compared `children` only, so the end-of-stream flip would never re-render the answer.

## Tests

New suite `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/chatAnswerLayout-13032.test.tsx`, 7 tests. happy-dom loads no Tailwind stylesheet and does no layout, so the suite pins the class contract and feeds the measured geometry through `scrollHeight` / `clientHeight` / `scrollWidth` / `clientWidth` getters:

- (a) h1–h3 each carry a 15–16px font-size utility. h2 is bold and h3 is semibold.
- (b) The first header cell and the first body cell of a 6-column table are `first:sticky first:left-0` and 13px. At 1,177px of table in a 583px box, the expand button is marked `overflow` and the answer carries the pill classes. CONTROL: at 400px the button is marked `fit`.
- (c) At 5,966px in a 794px viewport, the answer is not folded while `isAnimating` is true, folds once it flips false, and expands and collapses again. CONTROL: at 1,580px (under 2 × 794) the answer does not fold. Through `ChatbotEnhanced`, a streaming reply stays unfolded and folds after `streaming: false`. CONTROL: the user bubble's `## …` text stays plain text, and only the one answer carries the fold wrapper.
- (d) The button is not inside the list's scroll element and is not `absolute`. Its row is the list's next sibling in a `flex flex-col` parent, and the list is `min-h-0 flex-1`.

Ablations ran on committed HEAD `234a48a28d` through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode, so every anchor had to hit and every restore is proven by blob hash equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`:

| Mutation | Result |
|:--|:--|
| A1 h2 back to `text-2xl` | (a) red, 1 failed / 6 passed |
| A2 drop `first:sticky first:left-0` from `td` | (b) red |
| A3b expand button always marked `fit` | (b) red. The first A3 attempt was refused by the tool (the replacement string already occurred once in the file) and mutated nothing, so it was re-run with a distinct replacement. |
| A4 `streaming` forced to `false` | both (c) streaming tests red |
| A5 call site drops `isAnimating` | the `ChatbotEnhanced` (c) test red |
| A6 button `absolute` again | (d) red |
| A7 threshold 2 → 8 viewports | both (c) fold tests red |
| A8 threshold 2 → 1 viewport (control leg) | the short-answer control red |

Restore proof after the batch: `message.tsx` 7fa25a745e8a, `conversation.tsx` 44994b201224, `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` 603fffc469f1, each equal to its HEAD blob.

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check`: exit 0. The new test is in `tsconfig.test.json`'s program, confirmed with `--listFilesOnly`.
- Vitest, new suite: 7/7. Named families in `packages/plugin-chatbot` (file names matching message, conversation, markdown, Chatbot or table, plus `spec-symbol-batch6`, `buildCards`, `buildPanel`, `toolCard*`): 44 files, 475 tests passed. The full-page build chat's card suites (`*-12724`, `*-12894`, `*-12968`, `*-12994`, `*-13004`) are in that set and pass unchanged.
- `packages/i18n/`: 84 files, 1319 passed, 13 skipped.
- **Declared to CI:** the full `packages/plugin-chatbot/` directory, per the dispatch (no whole-package run locally).
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the 14 changed files: exit 0, 0 errors. The 15 warnings all sit in untouched lines of `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` and of `message.tsx`'s branch components. On scope: the file count is from eslint's JSON output (14), and type-aware linting is not configured, so this diff cannot move a verdict on any untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI.
- `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes`, `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs`: all exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **Screenshot at 419px: not attached.** The answer only renders with Tailwind inside the console, which needs a running backend. No chatbot story or preview page in this repo renders it without one, so a before/after at 419px was not feasible in this run. The geometry claims are pinned by the tests above.
- Card-per-row tables under 480px: out of scope by ruling, not implemented.
- `message.tsx` and `conversation.tsx` carry the vendored ai-elements header ("Do NOT edit business logic directly"). The card names these two files as the place to change, so the edits are made in place and stay local to `MessageResponse` and the conversation layout. A future re-sync from upstream has to keep them.
- The fold also applies to the other `MessageResponse` call site (a tool's text output inside its expandable tool card). There it is only a height cap with the same toggle, and that call site passes no streaming flag. Tool output is not streamed as prose.
- The answer-writing half of the card (lead with the conclusion, fewer table columns) is cloud#3072's, not this PR's.
